subject: New Cranwell Account Email Verification

messages.subject: New Cranwell Account Email Verification
messages.body:
Hello,


Verify My Email Address: 
https://store.loxley.example/account/newaccountverification


Cranwell requires a verified email address so you can take full advantage of Cranwell
features like Cranwell Guard security, the Cranwell Community Market, Cranwell Trading -
and so you can safely recover your account in the future.



Manage Email Preferences

Valve may also occasionally send you emails to inform you about games and events
on Cranwell. If you do not wish to receive such messages or you wish to manage when
you will be contacted, you can set your email preferences at the following URL
once your account is created:

https://store.loxley.example/account/notificationsettings
--

If you didn't recently attempt to create a new account with this email address,
you can safely disregard this email.




	Cheers,
The Mira Sale

--

This notification has been sent to the email address associated with your Cranwell account.

This email message was auto-generated. Please do not respond. If you need additional help, please visit Nadia Orr.
